instrument_name: ND Income Tax Withholding & Information Returns Guideline (current web edition)
authority: ND Office of State Tax Commissioner
figure_or_rule_carried: Withhold if wages subject to federal withholding AND services in ND, or ND resident working outside ND (exception: ND-based employer required to withhold the other state's tax); wages = IRC 3401 wages (domestic service in a private home excluded); NRA: separate W-4 marked 'North Dakota only - nonresident alien', Single, no Exempt, treaty exemption not recognised unless it names states; exempt: interstate carrier nonresidents (49 USC 11502/40116/14503), MN/MT residents with NDW-R (renew by Feb 28; MN resident must return home monthly), enrolled tribal member living and working on a reservation, farmer/rancher agricultural wages (57-38-60(10)), military pay deduction wages, military spouse with NDW-M (renew by Jan 31), nonresident mobile workforce <= 20 days (57-38-59.3). Severance to a nonresident sourced by the ratio of past ND service. Registration via ND TAP; payroll service provider designated on the registration form. Form 306 quarterly due Apr 30/Jul 31/Oct 31/Jan 31; annual option if prior-year withholding < 1,000 and four timely quarters; e-file mandatory if prior-year withholding >= 1,000 or a third-party provider e-files federally; penalty 5% or 5.00 min (max 25%), interest 1%/month. W-2 (and 1099/W-2G with ND tax) e-file mandatory (57-38-60(12), from 2022), due Jan 31; EFW2 (SSA 42-007), W-2c EFW2C; TAP upload or web service; 1099 payor state ID = FEIN + '01'; third-party sick pay reconciliation statement
